The audience remained dyspathetic throughout the speech. 在整個演講過程中，聽眾保持冷淡。
Dyspathy is the opposite of sympathy and involve a lack of shared feeling. 反感是同情的對立面，涉及缺乏共同情感。
He felt a deep sense of dyspathy for his rivals. 他對他的對手感到深深的反感。
He suffers from chronic dyspepsia after eating spicy food. 吃完辛辣食物後，他患有慢性消化不良。
Dyspepsia can cause bloating and discomfort in the stomach. 消化不良會引起胃部脹氣和不適。
Dyspepsy is a common ailment that affects many people. 消化不良是影響許多人的常見疾病。
Avoiding large meals can help reduce the frequency of dyspepsy. 避免大餐可以幫助減少消化不良的頻率。
He had a dyspeptic expression on his face throughout the meeting. 在整個會議中，他臉上一直掛著不悅的表情。
A dyspeptic person is often irritable and hard to please. 消化不良（或脾氣壞）的人通常易怒且難以討好。
The doctor provided a dyspeptical diagnosis for the stomach pain. 醫生對胃痛給出了消化不良的診斷。
She followed a strict diet due to her dyspeptical symptoms. 由於消化不良症狀，她遵循嚴格的飲食。
He grumbled dyspeptically about the poor service. 他因消化不良（或心情不好）而對惡劣的服務嘀咕著。
She reacted dyspeptically to any suggestions for change. 她對任何變革建議都反應冷淡。
Dysphagia can make it difficult and painful to swallow food. 吞嚥困難會使吞嚥食物變得困難且痛苦。
The patient was evaluated for dysphagia after the stroke. 病人在中風後接受了吞嚥困難評估。
A dysphagic diet often consists of thickened liquids and soft foods. 吞嚥困難飲食通常由增稠的液體和軟食組成。
The nurse assisted the dysphagic patient during mealtime. 護士在用餐時間協助吞嚥困難的病人。
Dysphasia is a language disorder that results from brain damage. 言語障礙是腦損傷導致的一種語言障礙。
He struggled with expressive dysphasia after the accident. 事故發生後，他飽受表達性言語障礙之苦。
The dysphasic patient used gestures to communicate his needs. 這位言語障礙的病人用手勢來表達他的需求。
Therapy can help improve the speech of a dysphasic person. 治療可以幫助改善言語障礙者的說話能力。
Dysphemia is a clinical term for stuttering or stammering. Dysphemia 是口吃或結巴的臨床術語。
The child's dysphemia became more pronounced when he was nervous. 這孩子緊張時口吃會變得更加明顯。
Dysphonia can cause a hoarse or raspy voice. 發聲困難會導致聲音沙啞。
The singer sought medical help for her persistent dysphonia. 歌手為她持續的發聲困難尋求醫療幫助。
He had a dysphonic voice due to the cold. 由於感冒，他發聲困難。
The teacher became dysphonic after a long day of lecturing. 教師在長達一天的講課後變得發聲困難。
Gender dysphoria is the distress caused by a mismatch between gender identity and assigned sex. 性別不安是指因性別認同與出生時性別不一致而引起的困擾。
He experienced a sense of dysphoria during the winter months. 他在冬季幾個月裡感到一種心情不佳。

meaning: 躁動不安的；心情不佳的
sentences: The patient had a dysphoric mood throughout the day. 病人整天心情都不好。
She felt dysphoric and restless after hearing the news. 聽到這個消息後，她感到躁動不安。
The dysphotic zone of the ocean receives very little sunlight. 海洋的微光帶接收到的陽光非常少。
Specialized creatures live in the dysphotic depths of the sea. 專門的生物生活在海洋的微光深處。
Dysphrasia involves difficulty in correctly arranging words in a sentence. 遣詞障礙涉及難以在句子中正確安排詞語。
The doctor examined the patient for signs of dysphrasia. 醫生檢查病人是否有遣詞障礙的跡象。

meaning: 精神分裂 (舊稱)；精神障礙
sentences: The nurse wrote down dysphrenia during the checkup. 護理師在檢查時記下精神分裂。
The doctor explained dysphrenia to the patient. 醫生向病人解釋精神分裂。
Dyspituitarism can affect growth and metabolism. 腦垂體功能障礙可能影響生長和代謝。

Hip dysplasia is a common condition in some dog breeds. 髖關節發育不良是某些犬種常見的狀況。
Cervical dysplasia involves abnormal cell growth on the cervix. 子宮頸發育不良涉及子宮頸上異常的細胞生長。
The doctor monitored the dysplastic cells for any changes. 醫生監測發育不良的細胞是否有任何變化。
Dysplastic nevi are unusual moles that may increase the risk of melanoma. 發育不良痣是可能增加黑色素瘤風險的異常痣。
Dyspnea can be caused by heart or lung problems. 呼吸困難可能由心臟或肺部問題引起。
The patient complained of sudden dyspnea after climbing the stairs. 病人抱怨爬樓梯後突然呼吸困難。
The physician observed the patient's dyspneal symptoms. 醫生觀察了病人的呼吸困難症狀。
Dyspneal attacks can be very frightening for patients. 呼吸困難的發作對病人來說可能非常可怕。
The dyspneic patient was given supplemental oxygen. 呼吸困難的病人接受了氧氣補充。
He became dyspneic during the exercise test. 他在運動測試中變得呼吸困難。
Dyspnoic breathing is a sign of respiratory distress. 呼吸困難的呼吸是呼吸窘迫的跡象。
The medical team focused on stabilizing the dyspnoic patient. 醫療團隊致力於穩定呼吸困難的病人。
Dysprosia is the oxide form of the element dysprosium. 氧化鏑是元素鏑的氧化物形式。
The properties of dysprosia were studied in the chemical laboratory. 氧化鏑的性質在化學實驗室中被研究。
Dysprosium is a rare earth metal with the symbol Dy. 鏑是一種稀土金屬，符號為 Dy。
Dysprosium is used in high-intensity lamps and nuclear reactors. 鏑用於高強度燈和核反應堆中。
Dysraphia refers to a failure of the neural tube to close. 縫合不全是指神經管未能閉合。

Dyssnite is an older name for a variety of rhodonite. Dyssnite 是薔薇輝石變種的一個舊稱。
He added a sample of dyssnite to his mineral collection. 他將黑銠石樣本加入到他的礦物收藏中。
Dyssodia is a medical term for a foul or unpleasant odor. 惡臭是一個用於描述難聞氣味的醫學術語。
The doctor investigated the cause of the patient's dyssodia. 醫生調查了病人身上惡臭的原因。
Dysspermatism is a condition that affects male reproductive function. 射精困難是影響男性生殖功能的一種狀況。
The patient sought treatment for his dysspermatism. 病人為其射精困難尋求治療。
Dyssynergia involves a lack of coordination between muscle groups. 協調不全涉及肌肉群之間缺乏協調。
Pelvic floor dyssynergia can cause problems with elimination. 盆底協調不全會導致排泄問題。
Dyssystole refers to an incomplete or abnormal cardiac contraction. 心收縮不全是指心臟收縮不完全或異常。
The cardiologist analyzed the patient's dyssystole using an EKG. 心臟科醫生使用心電圖分析了病人的心收縮不全。
Dystaxia is a mild form of ataxia, or lack of muscle control. 動作不協調是共濟失調（或缺乏肌肉控制）的一種輕微形式。
The patient showed signs of dystaxia in his walk. 病人在走路時顯示出動作不協調的跡象。
A dystectic mixture has a higher melting point than its components. 難熔混合物的熔點高於其組成部分。
The researcher studied the dystectic properties of the alloy. 研究人員研究了該合金的難熔性質。
Dysteleological arguments suggest that the universe has no inherent purpose. 無目的論的論據表明宇宙沒有固有的目的。
The philosopher explored the dysteleological nature of existence. 哲學家探索了存在之無目的性質。
A dysteleologist believes that biological features have no final cause. 無目的論者相信生物特徵沒有最終原因。
The writings of the dysteleologist were debated by theologians. 無目的論者的著作受到了神學家的爭論。
Dysteleology is the study of organs or features that seem to have no function. 無目的論是研究似乎沒有功能的器官或特徵的學問。
The concept of dysteleology was introduced in the 19th century. 無目的論的概念是在 19 世紀引入的。
Dysthyroidism can lead to weight changes and fatigue. 甲狀腺功能障礙可能導致體重變化和疲勞。

Dystocia can be caused by the position of the fetus. 難產可能由胎位引起。

The dystome organism has an underdeveloped mouth structure. 口部不全的生物具有發育不全的口部結構。
They observed the dystome features in the larval stage. 他們在幼蟲階段觀察到了口部不全的特徵。
The dystomic classification refers to certain types of invertebrates. 口部不全的分類是指某些類型的無脊椎動物。
The researcher studied the dystomic adaptations of the species. 研究人員研究了該物種口部不全的適應性。
Dystomous creatures often feed through absorption. 口部不全的生物通常通過吸收進食。
The textbook described the anatomy of dystomous animals. 教科書描述了口部不全動物的解剖結構。
Muscular dystrophia is a group of diseases that cause muscle weakness. 肌肉萎縮是一組引起肌肉虛弱的疾病。
The patient showed signs of retinal dystrophia. 病人顯示出視網膜萎縮的跡象。
Dystrophic lakes are high in organic matter and low in nutrients. 營養不良湖泊含有高有機質但低營養鹽。

The brass component began to dezinc over time. 黃銅組件隨著時間的推移開始脫鋅。
They developed a coating to prevent parts from being dezinced. 他們開發了一種塗層來防止零件脫鋅。
Dezincation can weaken the structural integrity of plumbing. 脫鋅作用會削弱管道的結構完整性。
The failure was caused by severe dezincation. 故障是由嚴重的脫鋅作用引起的。
Dezincification is a form of corrosion in brass alloys. 脫鋅作用是黃銅合金中的一種腐蝕形式。
The researchers studied the process of dezincification. 研究人員研究了脫鋅作用的過程。
Corrosive water can dezincify brass fittings. 腐蝕性水會使黃銅配件脫鋅。
The chemical treatment was used to dezincify the alloy. 化學處理被用來使合金脫鋅。
The process was designed to dezymotize the mixture. 該過程旨在使混合物不發酵。
He sought a way to dezymotize the solution effectively. 他尋求一種有效消毒（去酶）溶液的方法。
The warrior carried a traditional dha. 戰士攜帶著一把傳統的長柄刀。
A dha is characterized by its long handle and curved blade. 長柄刀的特徵是長柄和彎刃。
The dhabb is a type of spiny-tailed lizard. dhabb 是一種刺尾蜥蜴。
The dhabb lives in arid desert regions. dhabb 生活在乾旱的沙漠地區。
The dhai assisted with the birth of the baby. 奶媽（助產士）協助了嬰兒的出生。
The dhai was highly respected in the village. 奶媽在村子裡備受尊敬。
The dhak tree is known for its bright orange flowers. 紫礦樹以其亮橘色的花朵而聞名。
Dhak wood is used for various purposes in India. 紫礦木在印度被用於各種用途。
The dhamnoo grew quickly after the rain. 纖維植物名在雨後長得很快。
The farmer planted dhamnoo beside the field. 農民在田邊種下纖維植物名。
The farmers harvested the dhan after the rainy season. 農民在雨季後收割稻穀。
Dhan is a staple crop in many parts of South Asia. 稻穀是南亞許多地區的主食作物。
The Dhangar community is traditionally involved in sheep herding. Dhangar 社群傳統上從事牧羊工作。
He met a Dhangar while traveling through the rural regions. 他在穿越鄉村地區時遇到了一位 Dhangar。
The Dhanuk people have a long history of serving as archers. Dhanuk 人在擔任弓箭手方面有著悠久的歷史。
He studied the cultural traditions of the Dhanuk. 他研究了 Dhanuk 的文化傳統。
The ancient hero used a powerful dhanush in battle. 古代英雄在戰鬥中使用了一張強大的弓。
The dhanush is an important symbol in Indian mythology. 弓是印度神話中的重要象徵。
Dhanvantari is considered the physician of the gods in Hinduism. 在印度教中，訶利陀被認為是眾神的醫生。
The statue of Dhanvantari was placed in the hospital. 訶利陀的雕像被放置在醫院裡。
Dharana is the sixth stage of yoga, focusing on concentration. 執持是瑜伽的第六個階段，專注於精神集中。
Practicing dharana helps to calm the mind. 練習執持（專注）有助於平靜心靈。
The monk recited a powerful dharani during the ceremony. 僧侶在儀式中背誦了一段強大的陀羅尼。
Dharani are often used in Buddhist practices for protection. 陀羅尼常在佛教修行中被用於尋求保護。
The dharmakaya represents the ultimate reality in Buddhism. 法身代表佛教中的終極實相。
He studied the concept of dharmakaya in his philosophy class. 他在哲學課上研究了法身的概念。

meaning: 法典（印度教法律與規則）
sentences: The Dharmashastra provides guidance on social and ethical duties. 法典為社會和道德職責提供了指導。
Scholars analyzed the ancient texts of the Dharmashastra. 學者們分析了古代法典的文本。

meaning: 印度教法律與宗教傳統的法典
sentences: The Dharmasmriti contains traditional laws and social conduct for Hindus. 《達摩法典》包含了印度教徒的傳統法律和社會行為準則。
The legal principles in the Dharmasmriti are considered sacred. 《達摩法典》中的法律原則被視為神聖。

meaning: 關於達摩（法）的梵文法典
sentences: The Dharmasutra provides guidelines for rituals and moral duties. 《達摩經》提供了祭祀和道德責任的指導方針。
Scholars study the Dharmasutra to understand ancient Indian social norms. 學者研究《達摩經》以了解古代印度的社會規範。

meaning: 供朝聖者居住的免費客棧
sentences: The pilgrims stayed at a dharmsala near the temple. 朝聖者住在寺廟附近的一家宗教客棧。
Each dharmsala provides basic accommodation for travelers. 每家宗教客棧都為旅行者提供基本的住宿。

meaning: 靜坐示威（常在債務人門口以索債或抗議）
sentences: The workers staged a dharna outside the factory gates. 工人們在工廠大門外進行了靜坐示威。
Dharna is a traditional method of nonviolent protest in South Asia. 靜坐示威是南亞地區一種傳統的非暴力抗議方法。

meaning: 印度產的一種用於建築或工業的樹木或木材
sentences: The dhaura grew quickly after the rain. 印度產的一種用於建築或工業的樹木或木在雨後長得很快。
The farmer planted dhaura beside the field. 農民在田邊種下印度產的一種用於建築或工業的樹木或木。

meaning: 一種印度產的開花樹木，常用於製作染料
sentences: The red flowers of the dhauri tree are used to make traditional dyes. dhauri 樹的紅花被用來製作傳統染料。
Dhauri is valued for both its medicinal properties and its aesthetic beauty. dhauri 因其藥用價值和美觀而受到重視。

meaning: 印度的一種樹木，其木材極其堅硬，常被稱為「印度口香糖樹」
sentences: Dhava wood is so hard that it is often used to make tool handles. dhava 木材非常堅硬，常用於製作工具手柄。
The dhava tree yields a gum that is used in several local industries. dhava 樹產生一種用於多個當地工業的樹膠。

meaning: 一種類似於雲杉或冷杉的針葉樹
sentences: The dhaw grew quickly after the rain. 類似於雲杉或冷杉的針葉樹在雨後長得很快。
The farmer planted dhaw beside the field. 農民在田邊種下類似於雲杉或冷杉的針葉樹。

meaning: 天津四（天鵝座中最亮的恆星，也拼作 Deneb）
sentences: Dheneb is one of the stars that forms the Summer Triangle. 天津四是構成夏季大三角的恆星之一。
Astronomers have studied the spectrum of Dheneb to understand massive stars. 天文學家研究了天津四的光譜，以了解大質量恆星。

meaning: （印度或巴基斯坦的）土墩、土堆或墳塚
sentences: The archaeologists excavated an ancient dheri in the Punjab region. 考古學家在旁遮普地區挖掘了一個古代土塚。
Local legends say a great king is buried beneath the dheri. 當地傳說土塚下面埋葬著一位偉大的國王。

meaning: （印度、巴基斯坦等地的）洗衣工人
sentences: The dhobi collected the dirty laundry from the hotel this morning. 洗衣工人今天早上從酒店收走了髒衣服。
A dhobi ghat is a traditional open-air laundry where many dhobis work. 洗衣場是許多洗衣工人工作的傳統露天洗衣場所。

meaning: 豺（產於亞洲的一種野生犬科動物）
sentences: The dhole is an endangered wild dog native to Asia. 豺是原產於亞洲的一種瀕危野狗。
Dholes usually hunt in packs and are known for their distinctive whistling calls. 豺通常成群狩獵，並以其獨特的哨聲而聞名。

meaning: 多尼船（馬爾地夫或南印度的一種傳統多用途帆船）
sentences: The fishermen went out to sea in a traditional wooden dhoni. 漁民們乘著傳統的木製多尼船出海。
A dhoni can be used for transportation, fishing, or even as a houseboat. 多尼船可用於運輸、捕魚，甚至作為船屋。

meaning: （多指音樂中）嗡嗡聲或單調的低音
sentences: The steady dhoon of the engine put the child to sleep. 發動機持續的嗡嗡聲讓孩子睡著了。
There was a low dhoon coming from the back of the theater. 劇院後方傳來一陣低沉的嗡嗡聲。

meaning: 兜提（印度男性穿的一種傳統下身圍裙）
sentences: He wore a clean white dhoti for the wedding ceremony. 他穿著一件乾淨的白色兜提參加婚禮儀式。
The dhoti is a traditional garment that is wrapped around the waist and legs. 兜提是一種包裹在腰部和腿部的傳統服裝。

meaning: （方言或變體）鼓聲；也可能是「惡魔」的變體 (ghoul)
sentences: We heard the rhythmic dhoul of the drums in the distance. 我們聽到遠處傳來有節奏的鼓聲。
The old legends spoke of a dhoul that haunted the deep valleys. 古老的傳說講述了一個在深谷中出沒的惡魔。

meaning: 單桅帆船（常見於紅海和印度洋）
sentences: The dhow sailed gracefully across the Arabian Sea. 單桅帆船優雅地航行在阿拉伯海上。
Merchants have used dhows for centuries to transport spices and textiles. 幾個世紀以來，商人們一直使用單桅帆船運輸香料和紡織品。

meaning: 持國（印度史詩《摩訶婆羅多》中的一位盲國王）
sentences: King Dhritarashtra was the father of the Kauravas. 持國王是俱盧族的父親。
The blindness of Dhritarashtra is a central theme in the epic. 持國的失明是這部史詩的一個中心主題。
The word dhu is often seen in Scottish place names meaning black. dhu 這個詞經常出現在蘇格蘭地名中，意思是黑色。
The loch looked deep and dhu under the stormy sky. 在暴風雨的天空下，湖水顯得深邃而幽黑。

meaning: 田菁屬的一種植物，其纖維可用於製作繩索
sentences: Farmers grow dhunchee as a green manure crop to enrich the soil. 農民種植田菁作為綠肥作物以肥沃土壤。
The strong fibers of the dhunchee plant are ideal for making rope. 田菁植物強韌的纖維非常適合製作繩索。

meaning: 一種印度教儀式中使用的香爐
sentences: The priest waved the dhunchi to spread the fragrant smoke during the prayer. 祭司在祈禱時揮動香爐，散發香煙。
Traditional dhunchis are often made of clay or brass. 傳統的香爐通常由粘土或黃銅製成。

meaning: 耆那教中一個嚴格的教派成員
sentences: The festival invited a Dhundia to perform. 節慶邀請一位耆那教中一個嚴格的教派成員表演。
The article described the work of a Dhundia. 文章描述了一位耆那教中一個嚴格的教派成員的工作。

meaning: 蜀黍；高粱（非洲和亞洲廣泛種植的穀物）
sentences: Dhurra is a major food staple in many dry regions of Africa. 高粱是非洲許多乾旱地區的主要主食。
The harvested dhurra was stored in large clay containers. 收穫的高粱被儲存在大型粘土容器中。

meaning: 鵲鴝（一種產於亞洲的小型鳴禽，也拼作 dayal）
sentences: The dhyal is famous for its beautiful and complex song. 鵲鴝以其優美且複雜的歌聲而聞名。
I saw a black and white dhyal perched on the garden fence. 我看見一隻黑白相間的鵲鴝棲息在花園籬笆上。

meaning: 禪定；冥想（印度宗教術語）
sentences: Practicing dhyana helps to achieve a state of mental calm. 練習禪定有助於達到心理平靜的狀態。
Dhyana is an essential part of yoga and spiritual development. 禪定是瑜伽和精神發展的重要組成部分。
The prefix di- is used in chemistry to indicate two atoms or groups. 字首 di- 在化學中用於表示兩個原子或基團。
In music, a dichord is an instrument with only two strings. 在音樂中，dichord 是一種只有兩根弦的樂器。

meaning: 輝綠岩（一種細粒至中粒的火成岩）
sentences: The mountain range is primarily composed of dark diabase. 該山脈主要由深色的輝綠岩組成。
Geologists identified the specimen as a type of diabase. 地質學家將該標本鑑定為一種輝綠岩。

meaning: 輝綠岩的；具有輝綠岩性質的
sentences: The rock exhibited a diabasic texture under the microscope. 顯微鏡下，該岩石呈現出輝綠岩質結構。
Diabasic intrusions are common in the earth's crust. 輝綠岩侵入體在地球地殼中很常見。

meaning: 致糖尿病的（引起或加重糖尿病的）
sentences: Certain medications may have a diabetogenic effect on some patients. 某些藥物可能對某些患者產生致糖尿病作用。
Researchers are studying the diabetogenic properties of various diets. 研究人員正在研究各種飲食的致糖尿病特性。

meaning: 致糖尿病的（引起或產生糖尿病的，與 diabetogenic 同義）
sentences: A high-sugar diet can be considered diabetogenous over time. 長期的高糖飲食可被視為具有致糖尿病性。
The diabetogenous nature of the chemical was confirmed in clinical trials. 該化學物質的致糖尿病性質在臨床試驗中得到證實。

meaning: 糖尿病計（用於測量尿糖水平的儀器）
sentences: The physician used a diabetometer to monitor the patient's condition. 醫生使用糖尿病計來監測患者的狀況。
Advances in technology have led to more portable and accurate diabetometers. 技術進步導致了更便攜、更準確的糖尿病計。

meaning: 惡作劇；邪術；魔鬼般的行為
sentences: The children's innocent diablerie kept the parents entertained. 孩子們天真的惡作劇讓父母們感到很有趣。
The old tales are full of magic, mystery, and diablerie. 古老的故事充滿了魔法、神秘和邪術。
In some mythologies, a diabolarch rules over the underworld. 在某些神話中，魔王統治著冥界。
The story depicts a struggle against a powerful diabolarch. 故事描繪了與強大魔王的鬥爭。
The kingdom fell into a period of chaos and diabolarchy. 王國陷入了一段混亂和惡魔統治的時期。
The rebels sought to overthrow the oppressive diabolarchy. 反叛者試圖推翻壓迫性的惡魔政權。
The villagers whispered about secretive practices of diabolatry in the forest. 村民們竊竊私語，談論森林裡秘密進行的魔鬼崇拜活動。
Historical records show that diabolatry was severely punished. 歷史記錄顯示，魔鬼崇拜曾受到嚴厲懲罰。

meaning: 被魔鬼附身（的一種精神狀態）
sentences: In medieval times, many cases of mental illness were misdiagnosed as diabolepsy. 在中世紀，許多精神疾病案例被誤診為魔鬼附身。
The patient exhibited symptoms that were once associated with diabolepsy. 該患者表現出的症狀曾與魔鬼附身聯繫在一起。

meaning: 被魔鬼附身的；患有魔鬼附身症狀的
sentences: The old woman claimed to have seen a diaboleptic spirit in the cellar. 老婦人聲稱在地下室看到了一個被魔鬼附身的靈魂。
The physician analyzed the diaboleptic episodes of the troubled youth. 醫生分析了那個陷入困境的青年的魔鬼附身發作。

meaning: 惡魔般的；殘忍的；可惡的
sentences: The villain came up with a diabolic plan to destroy the city. 惡棍想出了一個摧毀城市的惡毒計劃。
He had a diabolic look in his eyes that frightened everyone. 他眼中閃爍著惡魔般的目光，嚇壞了所有人。
The complex puzzle was diabolically difficult to solve. 這個複雜的謎題難解得要命。
He laughed diabolically as he executed his revenge. 他在實施復仇時發出了惡魔般的笑聲。
The diabolicalness of the crime shocked the entire community. 這起犯罪的殘暴性質震驚了整個社區。
We were appalled by the pure diabolicalness of his actions. 我們對他行為中純粹的邪惡感到震驚。
The propaganda focused on the diabolification of the enemy's leaders. 宣傳的重點在於將敵方領導人魔鬼化。
The diabolification of traditional myths can change their cultural meaning. 將傳統神話魔鬼化會改變其文化含義。

meaning: 使魔鬼化；將...描述成魔鬼
sentences: Some critics tend to diabolify any political opposition. 一些評論家傾向於將任何政治反對派描述成魔鬼。
The movie diabolifies the antagonist to make the hero more sympathetic. 電影將反派魔鬼化，以使英雄更具同情心。
The novel explores themes of diabolism and ancient curses. 這部小說探索了魔鬼崇拜和古代詛咒的主題。
Accusations of diabolism were common during the witch trials. 在女巫審判期間，關於魔鬼崇拜的指控非常普遍。

meaning: 魔鬼崇拜者；行邪術的人
sentences: The diabolist claimed to have made a pact with dark forces. 那個魔鬼崇拜者聲稱與黑暗勢力簽訂了契約。
In the story, a diabolist performs a ritual in an abandoned abbey. 在故事中，一個魔鬼崇拜者在廢棄的修道院裡舉行儀式。
The diabolization of social groups often leads to prejudice. 對社會群體的魔鬼化往往會導致偏見。
Historians examine the diabolization of historical figures by their successors. 歷史學家研究後繼者對歷史人物的魔鬼化。

meaning: 使惡魔化；將...視為魔鬼（同 diabolify）
sentences: It is dangerous to diabolize those who have different opinions. 將持不同意見的人魔鬼化是危險的。
The media sometimes diabolizes celebrities for minor mistakes. 媒體有時會因為一些小錯誤而將名人魔鬼化。
The scholar presented a diabological analysis of the ancient text. 學者對這篇古文進行了魔鬼學分析。
Her library contains several rare diabological manuscripts. 她的圖書館藏有幾份罕見的魔鬼學手稿。

meaning: 魔鬼學（研究魔鬼的學問）
sentences: The professor is an expert in medieval diabology and folklore. 這位教授是中世紀魔鬼學和民俗學方面的專家。
Diabology explores the cultural history of demons and spirits. 魔鬼學探索惡魔和靈魂的文化歷史。

meaning: 魔鬼學（diabology 的另一種拼法）
sentences: Diabolology remains a niche field of study within theology. 魔鬼學在神學中仍然是一個小眾的研究領域。
He wrote a comprehensive book on the principles of diabolology. 他寫了一本關於魔鬼學原理的詳盡書籍。

meaning: 腐蝕；潰爛；穿孔（醫學術語）
sentences: The doctor observed a small diabrosis in the gastric lining. 醫生在胃粘膜中觀察到一個小的穿孔。
Chemical exposure can lead to the diabrosis of healthy tissue. 化學物質暴露會導致健康組織的腐蝕。
The diabrotic substance must be handled with extreme care. 腐蝕性物質必須極其小心地處理。
Diabrotic ulcers can be difficult to treat without proper medicine. 如果沒有適當的藥物，腐蝕性潰瘍可能難以治療。

meaning: 螢金蟬屬（一類農業害蟲，如玉米根蟲）
sentences: Beetles of the Diabrotica genus can cause significant damage to crops. 螢金蟬屬的甲蟲會對農作物造成重大損害。
Farmers use various methods to control the Diabrotica population in their fields. 農民使用各種方法來控制田間螢金蟬屬的數量。
The biologist described the diacanthous structure of the new plant species. 生物學家描述了這種新植物物種的二刺結構。
A diacanthous defense mechanism protects the insect from predators. 一種雙刺防禦機制保護這種昆蟲免受捕食者的侵害。

meaning: 折射焦散線（光線經折射後產生的包絡線）
sentences: The physics student calculated the curve of the diacaustic in the lens. 物理系的學生計算了透鏡中折射焦散線的曲線。
Diacaustic patterns can be seen when light passes through a glass of water. 當光線穿過一杯水時，可以看到折射焦散圖案。

meaning: 二乙醯胺（一種有機化學化合物）
sentences: Diacetamide is used as a reagent in various organic syntheses. 二乙醯胺在各種有機合成中被用作試劑。

The lab report identified the presence of a diacetic compound. 實驗室報告鑑定出一種二乙酸化合物的存在。

meaning: 二乙酸甘油酯（甘油與乙酸生成的二酯）

Technicians checked the purity of the diacetine sample. 技術人員檢查了二乙酸甘油酯樣品的純度。

meaning: 二乙酮尿（尿液中出現二乙酮或乙醯乙酸）

meaning: 通便的；瀉藥的（醫學術語）

meaning: 硬膏劑；鉛硬膏（傳統藥物）

Diachylum was applied to the wound to promote healing. 硬膏劑被塗抹在傷口上以促進癒合。

meaning: 二元酸（能產生兩個氫離子的酸）
sentences: Sulfuric acid is a well-known example of a diacid. 硫酸是二元酸的一個著名例子。

meaning: 間隔重複法（一種修辭手法，即在一個詞或短語中間插入一個或幾個詞）

meaning: 具間隔齒的（與 diacranterian 同義）

The dickcissel is a small bird found in the grasslands of North America. 美洲草原雀是發現於北美草原的一種小鳥。
We spotted a dickcissel perched on a fence post during our birdwatching trip. 在我們的賞鳥之旅中，我們發現一隻美洲草原雀棲息在圍欄柱上。

meaning: （口語，用作強調）魔鬼；討厭鬼；（用來表示驚訝、憤怒等）
sentences: What the dickens is going on here? 這裡到底出了什麼鬼事？
The children are being little dickens today. 孩子們今天真是討厭的小淘氣。

meaning: 狄更斯的；狄更斯作品風格的
sentences: The poverty in some parts of the city was truly Dickensian. 城市某些地區的貧困狀況簡直就像狄更斯小說中描述的那樣。
He is a Dickensian scholar who has written several books on Victorian literature. 他是一位狄更斯研究學者，曾寫過幾本關於維多利亞時代文學的書。

meaning: 狄更斯及其作品的文物
sentences: The museum houses a large collection of Dickensiana, including original manuscripts. 博物館收藏了大量的狄更斯文物，包括原始手稿。
Collectors often pay high prices for rare items of Dickensiana. 收藏家常為稀有的狄更斯文物支付高價。

meaning: 討價還價；十個一組（尤指獸皮）
sentences: We spent all afternoon dickering over the price of the used car. 我們花了一下午時間就那輛二手車的價格討價還價。
Historically, skins were often traded in a dicker of ten. 從歷史上看，皮革常以十個一組進行交易。

meaning: 假胸；（汽車的）後座；小鳥；襯衫的前襟
sentences: He wore a dickey under his sweater to look like he was wearing a collared shirt. 他在毛衣下戴了一個假胸，看起來就像穿了件有領襯衫。
The old car had a dickey seat that could be folded out for extra passengers. 那輛老爺車有一個可以折疊出來供額外乘客使用的後座。
Look at the pretty little dickeybird in the tree! 看樹上那隻漂亮的小鳥！
She pointed to a dickeybird singing on the branch. 她指向一隻在樹枝上歌唱的小鳥。
Dickinsonite is a rare phosphate mineral found in granitic pegmatites. 迪磷鐵錳礦是發現於花崗偉晶岩中的一種罕見磷酸鹽礦物。
The specimen of dickinsonite was collected from a mine in Connecticut. 迪磷鐵錳礦標本採自康乃狄克州的一個礦井。
Dicksonia antarctica is a popular tree fern in temperate gardens. 蚌殼蕨是溫帶花園中受歡迎的一種木本蕨類植物。
The Dicksonia ferns reached impressive heights in the greenhouse. 蚌殼蕨在溫室中長到了令人印象深刻的高度。

meaning: （口語）不牢固的；虛弱的；假胸；襯衫前襟
sentences: I've got a dicky heart, so I have to be careful not to overexert myself. 我的心臟不太好，所以我必須小心不要過度勞累。
That chair looks a bit dicky; you might want to sit somewhere else. 那張椅子看起來有點不牢靠，你可能想坐到別的地方。
Diclidantheraceae is a small family of plants found in South America. Diclidantheraceae 是分佈在南美洲的一個小型植物科。
The classification of Diclidantheraceae has been debated by several botanists. Diclidantheraceae 的分類一直受到幾位植物學家的爭論。
Cornstarch mixed with water is a classic example of a dilatant fluid. 玉米澱粉加水混合是膨脹性流體的經典例子。
The dilatant properties of certain materials make them useful in body armor. 某些材料的膨脹特性使其在防彈衣中非常有用。
Certain drugs can dilatate the blood vessels to improve flow. 某些藥物可以使血管擴張以改善血流。
The pupils of the eyes will dilatate when exposed to darkness. 眼睛的瞳孔在黑暗中會擴張。

meaning: 擴張；膨脹（通常指器官或管道）
sentences: The doctor performed a dilatation of the patient's esophagus. 醫生為病人的食道進行了擴張術。
Thermal dilatation must be considered when building steel bridges. 建造鋼橋時必須考慮熱膨脹。
The medicine has a dilatative effect on the bronchial tubes. 這種藥物對支氣管有擴張作用。
Research focused on the dilatative properties of the new polymer. 研究集中在新聚合物的膨脹特性上。
The surgeon used a small dilatator to open the blocked vessel. 外科醫生使用一個小型擴張器來打開阻塞的血管。
The dilatator muscle of the pupil is responsible for widening the eye's opening. 瞳孔擴張肌負責擴大眼睛的開口。
Nitroglycerin is a potent dilatatory agent used in heart therapy. 硝化甘油是用於心臟治療的強效擴張劑。
The dilatatory response of the veins helps regulate body temperature. 靜脈的擴張反應有助於調節體溫。
The eye doctor used drops to dilate my pupils. 眼科醫生用滴眼液擴張了我的瞳孔。
She would often dilate upon the importance of good manners. 她常會詳述禮貌的重要性。
The patient had dilated pupils due to the medication. 由於藥物的關係，病人的瞳孔擴張了。
A dilated heart can be a sign of serious health issues. 心臟擴大可能是嚴重健康問題的徵兆。
The structure expanded dilatedly under the immense heat. 該結構在巨大的熱量下擴張地膨脹。
The blood vessels reacted dilatedly to the chemical stimulus. 血管對化學刺激產生了擴張性的反應。
The doctor measured the dilatedness of the blood vessel. 醫生測量了血管的擴張程度。
The dilatedness of the pupils indicated a neurological response. 瞳孔的擴張狀態顯示了神經系統的反應。
The specialized dilater was essential for the delicate surgery. 這種專用的擴張器對於這項精細的手術至關重要。
He acted as a dilater of ideas, spreading new concepts throughout the group. 他扮演了思想擴張者的角色，在整個群體中傳播新概念。
The balloon expanded dilatingly as more air was pumped in. 隨著注入更多空氣，氣球擴張地蓬勃起來。
The professor spoke dilatingly about the history of the ancient empire. 教授詳盡地講述了那個古代帝國的歷史。
The dilation of the pupils is a common reaction to low light. 瞳孔擴張是光線暗淡時的常見反應。
During labor, the doctor monitors the dilation of the cervix. 在分娩過程中，醫生會監測子宮頸的擴張情況。
The dilative force of the explosion was felt miles away. 爆炸的膨脹力在幾英里外都能感覺到。
Certain chemicals have a dilative effect on soft tissues. 某些化學物質對軟組織有擴張作用。
A dilatometer is used to measure the change in volume of a substance. 膨脹計用於測量物質體積的變化。
The scientist calibrated the dilatometer before starting the experiment. 科學家在開始實驗前校準了膨脹計。
The dilatometric analysis revealed the material's glass transition temperature. 膨脹分析揭示了該材料的玻璃轉化溫度。
They used a dilatometric method to study the phase transformation of steel. 他們使用膨脹法來研究鋼的相變。

meaning: 膨脹測量法；測量膨脹學
sentences: Dilatometry is a powerful tool in materials science for studying thermal expansion. 膨脹測量法是材料科學中研究熱膨脹的有力工具。
Advances in dilatometry have allowed for more precise measurements of tiny changes. 膨脹測量技術的進步使得對微小變化的測量更加精確。
The surgeon inserted a dilator to widen the narrow artery. 外科醫生插入了一個擴張器來加寬狹窄的動脈。
The iris dilator muscle controls the size of the pupil. 虹膜擴張肌控制瞳孔的大小。
The government acted dilatorily in response to the environmental crisis. 政府在應對環境危機方面採取的行動十分拖延。
He answered the email dilatorily, taking over a week to reply. 他回覆電子郵件很慢，花了一個多星期才回覆。
The manager was frustrated by the employee's chronic dilatoriness. 經理對該員工長期的拖延感到沮喪。
Such dilatoriness in making a decision could cost the company millions. 如此遲緩的決策可能會讓公司損失數百萬。
The law firm was criticized for its dilatory tactics in the lawsuit. 該律師事務所在訴訟中的拖延戰術受到了批評。
He was dilatory in paying his bills, which affected his credit score. 他付帳單總是慢吞吞的，這影響了他的信用評分。
The old poet wrote verses filled with pure dilection for his homeland. 這位老詩人寫下了充滿對祖國純潔喜愛的詩句。
In archaic texts, dilection often refers to a deep, spiritual love. 在古文中，dilection 常指一種深層的精神之愛。

meaning: 迪萊米人（中世紀伊朗的一個山地民族，也指其語言）
sentences: The Dilemi people played a significant role in Persian history during the Buyid era. 迪萊米人在白益王朝時期的波斯歷史中扮演了重要角色。
Some linguistic scholars study the remnants of the Dilemi dialect. 一些語言學者研究迪萊米方言的遺跡。
A Dilemite warrior was known for his bravery and skill in mountain warfare. 迪萊米戰士以其在山地作戰中的勇敢和技能而聞名。
The Dilemite dynasty expanded its influence across much of central Iran. 迪萊米王朝將其影響力擴大到伊朗中部的大部分地區。
The board faced a dilemmatic situation when choosing between profit and ethics. 董事會在利潤與倫理之間做選擇時面臨兩難局面。
The dilemmatic nature of the conflict made it hard to find a peaceful resolution. 衝突的兩難本質使得很難找到和平解決的方法。
She presented a dilemmatical argument that stumped her opponents. 她提出了一個讓對手難以應對的兩難論點。
The dilemmatical problems of modern society require complex solutions. 現代社會的兩難問題需要複雜的解決方案。
He stood dilemmatically between his duty and his personal feelings. 他在職責與個人情感之間感到兩難地徘徊。
The country was dilemmatically placed during the international trade dispute. 該國在國際貿易糾紛中處於進退兩難的境地。

meaning: 業餘愛好者；膚淺的涉獵者
sentences: As a dilettant of the arts, he enjoyed visiting galleries without much technical knowledge. 作為一名藝術愛好者，他喜歡參觀畫廊，但沒有太多的專業知識。
She was often dismissed as a mere dilettant by the serious academic community. 她常被嚴肅的學術界視為僅僅是一個膚淺的涉獵者而遭到排斥。

meaning: （藝術、科學等方面的）業餘愛好者；淺薄的涉獵者
sentences: He was a rich dilettante who spent his time painting and traveling. 他是個有錢的業餘愛好者，把時間花在繪畫和旅行上。
Don't be a dilettante; if you want to learn the piano, you must practice every day. 不要只是淺嚐輒止；如果你想學鋼琴，就必須每天練習。
His dilettanteish approach to scientific research led to several errors. 他對科學研究那種淺薄的態度導致了幾次錯誤。
The critic dismissed the exhibition as being too dilettanteish and lacking depth. 評論家批評該展覽過於業餘且缺乏深度。

meaning: 業餘愛好者的作風；淺薄涉獵
sentences: The professor warned against dilettanteism in the pursuit of historical truth. 教授警告在追求歷史真相時不要有淺薄涉獵的作風。
His dilettanteism was evident in the way he jumped from one hobby to another. 他從一個愛好跳到另一個愛好的方式顯露了他的淺薄涉獵。

meaning: 業餘愛好者的身份或地位
sentences: He enjoyed the freedom that came with his dilettanteship in the world of poetry. 他享受在詩歌界作為一名業餘愛好者所帶來的自由。
Her dilettanteship allowed her to explore many fields without the pressure of a career. 她的業餘身份讓她能夠探索許多領域，而沒有職業壓力。
The salon was a gathering place for the city's dilettanti to discuss the latest operas. 沙龍是城市裡的業餘愛好者們討論最新歌劇的聚會場所。
Many of the dilettanti present were more interested in the social scene than the music. 在場的許多愛好者對社交場合的興趣遠大於對音樂本身的興趣。

meaning: 業餘的；淺薄的；不專業的
sentences: The project suffered from a dilettantish lack of planning and oversight. 該項目因缺乏規劃和監督而顯得不專業。
Her dilettantish interest in photography never really developed into a serious skill. 她對攝影那種玩票性質的興趣從未真正發展成專業技能。

meaning: 業餘愛好；淺薄涉獵；玩票
sentences: True expertise requires years of study, not just casual dilettantism. 真正的專業知識需要多年的學習，而不僅僅是隨意的淺薄涉獵。
The movement was criticized for its dilettantism and lack of commitment to social change. 該運動因其玩票性質和對社會變革缺乏承諾而受到批評。
He had a dilettantist attitude toward gardening, planting things but never weeding. 他對園藝有一種玩票的態度，只管種植卻從不除草。
The dilettantist wrote reviews for the local paper just for fun. 這位業餘愛好者僅僅為了好玩而為當地報紙撰寫評論。

meaning: 勤勉；勤奮（較少見的用法，通常用diligence）
sentences: Through great diligency, the young scholar completed the massive translation. 憑藉著極大的勤勉，這位年輕學者完成了這項龐大的翻譯工作。
Diligency in one's duties is often rewarded with success. 盡忠職守的勤勉通常會獲得成功的報償。

meaning: 勤勉（拉丁語源，有時在法律或學術脈絡中使用）
sentences: The legal concept of 'diligentia' refers to the care required in performing a task. 法律上的「勤勉」概念是指執行任務時所需的謹慎。
He pursued his research with the diligentia of a medieval monk. 他以中世紀僧侶般的勤勉進行研究。
The teacher praised the student for her consistent diligentness in class. 老師表揚了這位學生在課堂上一貫的勤奮表現。
Her diligentness was clear to see in the high quality of her work. 從她高品質的工作成果中可以清楚地看出她的勤勉。
In the old village stories, the dilker was always getting into trouble. 在古老的村莊故事中，那個逃學者總是惹麻煩。
The local dilker spent most of his time wandering by the river. 當地那個遊手好閒的人大部分時間都在河邊漫遊。

meaning: 第倫桃屬（一種熱帶樹木）
sentences: The Dillenia tree is known for its large, fragrant flowers and edible fruit. 第倫桃屬樹木以其巨大芳香的花朵和可食用的果實而聞名。
Many species of Dillenia are native to Southeast Asia. 許多第倫桃屬物種原產於東南亞。
Dilleniaceae is a family of flowering plants that includes trees, shrubs, and lianas. 第倫桃科是一個開花植物科，包括喬木、灌木和藤本植物。
Botanists study Dilleniaceae to understand the evolution of early dicots. 植物學家研究第倫桃科以了解早期雙子葉植物的進化。
The forest is home to several dilleniaceous species that bloom in the rainy season. 這片森林是幾種在雨季開花的第倫桃科物種的家園。
Dilleniaceous plants are characterized by their distinct leaf venation. 第倫桃科植物的特徵是其獨特的葉脈。
As a tropical dilleniad, this plant requires a humid environment to thrive. 作為一種熱帶第倫桃科植物，這種植物需要潮濕的環境才能茂盛生長。
The garden's collection includes a rare dilleniad from the mountains of Borneo. 花園的藏品包括一種來自婆羅洲山區的稀有第倫桃科植物。
The dilli bag is traditionally woven from natural fibers by Aboriginal women. 這種編織袋傳統上是由原住民婦女用天然纖維編織而成的。
She used a dilli to collect bush tucker in the outback. 她用一個編織籃在內陸地區收集叢林食物。

meaning: 更傻的；更笨的（dilly的比較級）
sentences: That's a dillier idea than the last one you had! 那個主意比你上一個還要笨！
He looked dillier than ever in that oversized hat. 他戴著那頂超大的帽子看起來比以往任何時候都更傻。

meaning: 一種古老的肉粥或稀飯（傳統上在加冕典禮上供應）
sentences: Dilligrout was a ceremonial dish served at the coronation of English kings. 這種肉粥是在英國國王加冕典禮上供應的儀式菜餚。
The recipe for authentic dilligrout has been lost to time. 正宗肉粥的食譜已隨著時間流逝而失傳。

meaning: 心愛的小孩；家中的寵兒
sentences: As the youngest, he was always the dilling of the family. 作為年齡最小的孩子，他一直是家中的寵兒。
The old nursery rhyme mentions a dilling who is loved by all. 古老的童謠提到了一個深受大家喜愛的寵兒。
Crushed dillseed is a key ingredient in many pickling recipes. 壓碎的蒔蘿子是許多醃製食譜的關鍵成分。
The aroma of warm dillseed filled the kitchen. 溫暖的蒔蘿子香氣瀰漫在廚房裡。
The miners would dillue the ore to separate the tin from the waste. 礦工們會篩洗礦石，將錫與廢料分離。
Dillueing was a labor-intensive part of the mining process. 篩洗礦石是採礦過程中勞動強度很大的一部分。
The experienced dilluer could quickly spot bits of precious metal in the tray. 經驗豐富的篩洗工可以快速發現托盤中珍貴金屬的碎片。
They invested in a new mechanical dilluer to increase production. 他們投資了一台新的機械篩洗機以提高產量。

meaning: 蒔蘿草（新鮮或乾燥的葉子，用作香料）
sentences: Garnish the salmon with a sprinkle of fresh dillweed. 在鮭魚上撒上一點新鮮的蒔蘿草作為裝飾。
Dillweed adds a refreshing flavor to potato salad. 蒔蘿草為馬鈴薯沙拉增添了清爽的風味。
That new movie is a real dilly; you must see it! 那部新電影真是棒極了；你一定要看！
Don't be such a dilly, start working on your project. 別這麼傻，開始做你的項目吧。
He was a notorious dillydallier who never finished anything on time. 他是一個臭名昭著的拖延者，從不按時完成任何事情。
The manager has no patience for a dillydallier when deadlines are tight. 當截止日期很緊時，經理對磨蹭的人沒有耐心。
Stop dillydallying and get dressed, or we'll be late. 別磨蹭了，快穿好衣服，否則我們要遲到了。
We shouldn't dillydally on the way to the airport. 我們在去機場的路上不應該浪費時間。
They called him a dillyman because he believed every tall tale they told. 他們叫他傻瓜，因為他相信他們講的每一個荒誕故事。
He acted the dillyman to make the children laugh. 他裝傻來逗孩子們笑。
Oil from the dilo tree is used in traditional medicine for skin ailments. 來自胡桐樹的油被用於傳統醫學中治療皮膚病。
The dilo grows well in coastal sandy soils. 胡桐在沿海沙質土壤中生長良好。
The student marked the dilogy in the Hebrew word. 學生在希伯來文字裡標出雙關語。
The teacher pointed to the dilogy before reading aloud. 老師朗讀前指著雙關語。
Water is often used as a diluent for water-based paints. 水常用作水性漆的稀釋劑。
The chemist added a diluent substance to the concentrated acid. 化學家在濃酸中加入了稀釋物質。
She prefers her orange juice diluted with a bit of water. 她喜歡把柳橙汁加一點水稀釋後喝。
The original message became diluted as it passed through many people. 最初的訊息在經過許多人傳遞後變得模糊不清了。
The flavor was only dilutedly present in the soup. 這種味道在湯中僅以微弱的形式存在。
The company's influence was dilutedly felt in the new market. 該公司的影響力在新市場中顯得很薄弱。
The dilutedness of the solution made it ineffective for the test. 溶液的稀釋程度使其對測試無效。
They complained about the dilutedness of the coffee served at the diner. 他們抱怨餐廳供應的咖啡太淡了。

meaning: （戰時等）頂替技術工人的非熟練工人
sentences: Many a dilutee entered the factories during the labor shortage of the war. 在戰爭期間勞動力短缺時，許多非熟練工人進入了工廠。

Each stanza of the long poem was a structured dizain. 這首長詩的每一節都是結構化的十行詩。

meaning: 打扮；裝飾（通常指俗氣或過分的裝飾）
sentences: She chose to dizen herself in gaudy jewels for the party. 她選擇在派對上用花哨的珠寶把自己打扮起來。
The old hall was dizened with colorful streamers. 舊大廳裝飾著五彩繽紛的彩帶。

meaning: 打扮；裝飾（過於華麗或俗氣的）
sentences: Her elaborate dizenment attracted stares from everyone in the room. 她精心且華麗的打扮引起了房間裡每個人的注目。
He was confused by the sudden dizenment of the storefront. 他對店面突然出現的過度裝飾感到困惑。
The researcher identified the dizoic nature of the protozoan cyst. 研究人員鑑定出該原生動物囊腫具有雙孢子的特性。
Dizoic species are common in certain families of parasites. 雙孢子物種在某些寄生蟲家族中很常見。
Dizygotic twins are no more genetically similar than ordinary siblings. 異卵雙胞胎在遺傳上並不比普通兄弟姐妹更相似。
The study focused on the differences between monozygotic and dizygotic twins. 該研究側重於同卵雙胞胎和異卵雙胞胎之間的差異。
Don't be such a dizzard and pay attention to what I'm saying. 別像個傻瓜一樣，注意聽我說的話。
The old comedy featured a clumsy dizzard as the main character. 這部古老的喜劇以一個笨拙的傻瓜為主角。

meaning: 察合台語（一種古老的突厥語言）
sentences: Scholars study Djagatay to understand the history of Central Asian literature. 學者們研究察合台語以了解中亞文學的歷史。
Many classical texts in the region were written in Djagatay. 該地區的許多古典文獻都是用察合台語編寫的。

meaning: （歷史）札薩克（清代蒙古旗長的稱號）
sentences: The djasakid held significant administrative power over his tribe. 札薩克對他的部落擁有重大的行政權力。
Historical records detail the responsibilities of a djasakid. 歷史記錄詳細說明了札薩克的職責。

meaning: （植物）西非的一種油脂種子樹
sentences: Oil extracted from the djave tree is used in local cooking and soap making. 從西非油脂樹中提取的油被用於當地烹飪和肥皂製作。
The djave is a tall tree native to the tropical forests of West Africa. 西非油脂樹是西非熱帶森林原產的一種高大樹木。
The student marked the djehad in the Hebrew word. 學生在希伯來文字裡標出聖戰。
The teacher pointed to the djehad before reading aloud. 老師朗讀前指著聖戰。

meaning: 傑里布（中東部分地區使用的土地面積單位）
sentences: The farmer owned three djerib of fertile land near the river. 農民在河邊擁有三傑里布肥沃的土地。
A djerib is approximately equivalent to one hectare in some regions. 在某些地區，一傑里布大約相當於一公頃。

meaning: （阿爾及利亞）一種手工編織的羊毛毯子
sentences: She bought a beautiful djersa from the market in Algiers. 她在阿爾及爾的市場買了一條美麗的羊毛毯。
The intricate patterns on the djersa reflected local traditions. 羊毛毯上複雜的圖案反映了當地的傳統。

meaning: 恩朱卡人（蘇利南境內的馬龍人族群）
sentences: The Djuka people live along the banks of the Cottica River. 恩朱卡人居住在科蒂卡河沿岸。
Traditional Djuka art is famous for its intricate wood carvings. 傳統的恩朱卡藝術以其複雜的木雕而聞名。

meaning: 兩河之間的土地；河間地
sentences: The Gangetic Doab is a fertile region in Northern India. 恆河河間地是北印度一個肥沃的地區。
Villages flourished in the doab due to the easy access to water. 由於取水方便，村莊在河間地繁榮發展。
The legal document clearly outlined the widow's doarium. 法律文件清楚地列出了寡婦的遺產權利。
In medieval law, doarium ensured that a wife had means of support after her husband's death. 在中世紀法律中，寡婦產權確保了妻子在丈夫死後有生活來源。
The grandparents tend to doat on their youngest grandson. 祖父母往往溺愛他們最小的孫子。
She has continued to doat on him despite his many flaws. 儘管他有很多缺點，她仍然對他一往情深。
The carpenter discarded the doated timber as it was structurally unsound. 木匠丟棄了腐朽的木材，因為它在結構上不牢固。
High humidity caused the stacked logs to become doated. 高濕度導致堆放的原木開始腐朽。
The old man was becoming a doater, often forgetting simple things. 老人變得越來越糊塗，經常忘記簡單的事情。
As a doater of his pets, he bought them expensive treats every week. 作為一個溺愛寵物的人，他每週都給牠們買昂貴的零食。
The doating mother couldn't see any fault in her child. 溺愛的母親看不出她的孩子有任何缺點。
He smiled at his doating grandfather's repetitive stories. 他對著溺愛他的祖父重複講述的故事微笑。

meaning: 溺愛的；愚笨的；老糊塗的
sentences: His doatish behavior during the meeting was embarrassing. 他在會議期間愚笨的表現令人尷尬。
The doatish affection she showered on her cat was excessive. 她對貓表現出的溺愛過於火熱。

meaning: （天文學）杜布森式望遠鏡（Dobsonian telescope 的縮寫）
sentences: He set up his 10-inch Dob in the backyard for stargazing. 他在後院架起10英寸杜布森式望遠鏡來觀星。
A Dob is popular among amateur astronomers for its ease of use. 杜布森式望遠鏡因其易於使用而在業餘天文學家中很受歡迎。
He threatened to dob on his brother for breaking the vase. 他威脅要舉報他哥哥打破了花瓶。
In school, no one likes someone who dobs. 在學校裡，沒人喜歡告密的人。
She dobbed him in to the teacher for cheating. 她向老師舉報他作弊。
The thief was dobbed in by an anonymous caller. 小偷被一名匿名舉報者告發了。
Nobody wants to be seen as a dobber in this neighborhood. 在這個社區，沒人想被看作是告密者。
He played with his favorite blue dobber in the marble game. 他在彈珠遊戲中使用他最喜歡的藍色大彈珠。
The old dobbin pulled the cart slowly down the lane. 老馬拉著大車緩慢地走在小巷裡。
Children loved to ride the gentle dobbin at the farm. 孩子們喜歡在農場騎那匹溫順的老馬。
Dobbing on your friends is considered bad form. 舉報你的朋友被認為是不厚道的行為。
The police encourage the dobbing in of drug dealers. 警方鼓勵舉報販毒者。
The fabric was woven on a dobby loom to create a small geometric pattern. 這種織物是在多比織機上編織的，以產生小的幾何圖案。
He preferred shirts made of dobby cloth for their subtle texture. 他喜歡多比花紋布做的襯衫，因為它們有細微的紋理。

meaning: （美西俚語）泥磚；土坯房（adobe 的簡寫）
sentences: They lived in a small dobe hut in the desert. 他們住在沙漠裡的一個小土坯房裡。
The dobe walls kept the interior cool during the hot day. 泥磚牆在炎熱的白天保持室內涼爽。
The pirate's chest was filled with gold doblas and silver pieces. 海盜的箱子裡裝滿了多布拉金幣和銀幣。
Collectors are often looking for rare Spanish doblas. 收藏家經常尋找稀有的西班牙多布拉金幣。
He found an old doblon buried on the beach. 他在海灘上發現了一枚埋藏的古西班牙金幣。
The story mentions a hidden treasure of silver and doblons. 故事提到了一處埋藏著白銀和金幣的寶藏。

meaning: 多布拉（聖多美和普林西比的貨幣單位）
sentences: The traveler exchanged his dollars for Sao Tomean dobras. 旅行者將他的美金兌換成聖多美多布拉。
The price of the souvenir was five hundred dobras. 紀念品的價格是五百多布拉。

meaning: （古貨幣）大金幣（多布拉的一種形式）
sentences: The museum displayed a rare gold dobrao from the 18th century. 博物館展示了一枚18世紀罕見的多布拉金幣。
A dobrao was once a high-value coin in Portugal and Brazil. 多布拉曾是葡萄牙和巴西的高面值硬幣。

meaning: （拼寫變體）多比織機；小花紋布
sentences: The curtains were made of a light doby fabric. 窗簾是由輕薄的多比花紋織物製成的。
She admired the delicate weave of the doby material. 她讚賞多比材料精細的織法。

meaning: 醫生（doctor 的非正式稱呼）
sentences: Hey doc, can you take a look at my swollen ankle? 嘿醫生，你能看看我腫脹的腳踝嗎？
The doc told him to get plenty of rest and drink lots of fluids. 醫生告訴他要多休息並多喝水。
The docent gave a fascinating tour of the art gallery. 導覽員對藝廊進行了精彩的導覽。
She works as a volunteer docent at the local history museum. 她在當地的歷史博物館擔任志願導覽員。

meaning: 導覽員職位；大學教師職位
sentences: He applied for a docentship at the university's biology department. 他申請了大學生物系的教師職位。
During her docentship, she mentored several students. 在擔任大學教師期間，她指導了幾名學生。

meaning: 幻影派信徒（早期基督教的一派，認為耶穌身體只是幻影）
sentences: The Docetae were criticized by early church fathers for their views on Christ. 幻影派信徒因其對基督的看法而受到早期教會教父的批評。
Study of the Docetae is important for understanding early Gnosticism. 對幻影派的研究對於了解早期諾斯底主義非常重要。
His Docetic beliefs led him to reject the physical suffering of Jesus. 他的幻影派信仰使他拒絕接受耶穌肉體上的痛苦。
The Docetic heresy was a major concern in the second century. 幻影派異端是二世紀的一個主要問題。
The text interpreted the incarnation Docetically. 文本以幻影派的方式詮釋了道成肉身。
They argued Docetically that the divine could not truly suffer. 他們以幻影派的觀點辯稱，神聖者不可能真正受苦。
Docetism teaches that Christ only appeared to have a human body. 幻影派學說教導基督只是看起來有人類的身體。
The influence of Docetism can be seen in some apocryphal gospels. 幻影派學說的影響可以在一些偽經福音書中看到。
The festival invited a Docetist to perform. 節慶邀請一位幻影派者表演。
The article described the work of a Docetist. 文章描述了一位幻影派者的工作。
The Docetistic view was eventually declared heretical. 幻影派學說的觀點最終被宣佈為異端。
She researched the Docetistic tendencies in early mystical texts. 她研究了早期神秘文本中的幻影派傾向。
Later writers attempted to Docetize the accounts of Christ's life. 後來的作家試圖使基督生平的記載符合幻影派的觀點。
The theologian warned against the tendency to Docetize the faith. 神學家警告不要有使信仰幻影派化的傾向。

meaning: （古希臘詩歌）五音步詩節的；dochmius 音步的
sentences: The Greek tragedy featured a dochmiac meter in its choral odes. 這部希臘悲劇在合唱頌歌中使用了五音步詩節。
Scholars analyzed the complex dochmiac rhythm of the verse. 學者們分析了詩句中複雜的五音步節奏。
He studied the dochmiacal patterns in ancient lyric poetry. 他研究了古代抒情詩中的五音步模式。
The poet experimented with dochmiacal structures in his new work. 詩人在他的新作品中嘗試了五音步結構。
Dochmiasis is caused by parasites entering the body through the skin. 鉤蟲病是由寄生蟲通過皮膚進入人體引起的。
Public health efforts aim to reduce the incidence of dochmiasis in the region. 公共衛生工作旨在降低該地區鉤蟲病的發病率。
The dochmiius is a meter often associated with intense emotion. 五音步音節是一種常與強烈情感相關的音步。
Understanding the dochmius is essential for reading classic Greek drama. 了解五音步音節對於閱讀古典希臘戲劇至關重要。
The teacher praised the student's docibility and willingness to learn. 老師稱讚了學生的受教和學習願望。
Effective training requires a certain level of docibility in the trainee. 有效的培訓要求受訓者具備一定程度的受教性。
The puppy was very docible and quickly learned new tricks. 小狗非常容易教導，很快就學會了新把戲。
A docible nature makes the learning process much smoother. 溫順的性格使學習過程更加順利。
Her docibleness made her a favorite among the instructors. 她的溫順使她成為導師們的最愛。
The project success depended on the docibleness of the participants. 專案的成功取決於參與者的配合與受教。
The horse followed its master docilely back to the stable. 馬溫順地跟著主人回到馬廄。
He accepted the instructions docilely and went to work. 他順從地接受了指令並去工作。
The cat's docility surprised everyone, as it was usually very grumpy. 貓的溫順讓每個人都感到驚訝，因為牠通常脾氣很差。
She valued docility in her students more than raw talent. 她比起天賦更看重學生的溫順。

meaning: （醫學或金屬）檢驗；鑑定；（古希臘）資格審查
sentences: In ancient Athens, a docimasia was required before taking office. 在古代雅典，就職前需要進行資格審查。
The docimasia of the lung can determine if a newborn breathed. 肺部檢驗可以判定新生兒是否呼吸過。
The metallurgist performed a docimastic test on the ore sample. 冶金學家對礦石樣本進行了鑑定測試。
Docimastic procedures are essential for ensuring the purity of the metal. 鑑定程序對於確保金屬純度至關重要。

meaning: 檢驗的；鑑定用的（同 docimastic）
sentences: The lab used docimastical methods to evaluate the new alloy. 實驗室使用鑑定方法來評估新合金。
He wrote a treatise on docimastical arts and techniques. 他寫了一篇關於鑑定藝術和技術的論文。
The docimasy of coins was important to prevent counterfeiting. 硬幣的鑑定對於防止偽造非常重要。
She specialized in the docimasy of precious metals. 她專門從事貴金屬的鑑定。
Docimology involves the study of various testing methods for metals. 鑑定學涉及研究各種金屬測試方法。
The textbook covers the fundamentals of modern docimology. 這本教科書涵蓋了現代鑑定學的基礎知識。

meaning: （方言）機靈；受教性（docility 的變體）
sentences: The child showed great docity in picking up new languages. 這孩子在學習新語言方面表現出極大的機靈。
He was known for his docity and quick thinking. 他以機靈和思維敏捷而聞名。

meaning: 碼頭費；停泊費；扣除額（因穀物不純等）
sentences: The shipping company had to pay significant dockage fees at the port. 航運公司必須在港口支付巨額的停泊費。
The buyer applied a dockage for the excess chaff in the wheat. 買方因小麥中含有過多雜質而扣除了部分款項。

meaning: （蘇格蘭/北英格蘭）酸模（一種植物，同 dock）
sentences: He used a docken leaf to soothe the sting from a nettle. 他用酸模葉來緩解蕁麻造成的刺痛。
Docken grows wild along the edges of the field. 酸模在田邊野外生長。
The docker loaded the heavy crates onto the ship. 碼頭工人把沉重的木箱裝上船。
Many dockers went on strike to demand better working conditions. 許多碼頭工人舉行罷工，要求改善工作條件。

meaning: 摘要；（法院的）待審案件表；標籤
sentences: The case was added to the court's docket for next month. 該案件被列入下個月的法院待審名單。
The clerk attached a docket to the bundle of documents. 店員在文件包上貼了一個標籤。
The ship slowly approached the dockhead. 船緩慢地靠近碼頭前端。
We met at the dockhead to watch the sunset over the harbor. 我們在碼頭口見面，觀看海港的日落。
The dockmaster's office is located in the small dockhouse. 碼頭管理員的辦公室位於那個小碼頭建築內。
Goods were stored in the dockhouse before being loaded. 貨物在裝船前被存放在碼頭倉庫裡。

meaning: 碼頭化；將河流改造成船塢系統
sentences: The dockization of the river transformed the local economy. 河流的碼頭化改造轉變了當地經濟。
Plans for dockization were met with environmental concerns. 碼頭化計劃遭到了環境方面的擔憂。

meaning: 使碼頭化；將河流改造成船塢
sentences: The city decided to dockize the tidal creek to improve shipping. 城市決定將這條感潮溪流碼頭化，以改善航運。
Engineers worked to dockize the harbor for larger vessels. 工程師們致力於將港口碼頭化，以供更大的船隻停泊。
The old dockland has been redeveloped into luxury apartments. 舊碼頭區已被重新開發為豪華公寓。
He spent his childhood playing near the dockland cranes. 他的童年是在碼頭區起重機附近玩耍度過的。
Dockmackie is a shrub known for its maple-like leaves. 楓葉莢蒾是一種以其類似楓葉的葉子而聞名的灌木。
The dockmackie berries turn dark purple in the fall. 楓葉莢蒾的漿果在秋天變成深紫色。
The dockman helped secure the lines as the boat arrived. 船隻到達時，碼頭工人幫忙固定纜繩。
He has worked as a dockman for over twenty years. 他已經當了二十多年的碼頭工人。
The dockmaster assigned a berth to the incoming yacht. 碼頭管理員為進港的遊艇分配了泊位。
You should speak to the dockmaster about the storage fees. 你應該和碼頭管理員談談存儲費用。
A crowd gathered on the dockside to wave goodbye to the sailors. 一群人聚集在碼頭邊，向水手們揮手告別。
They opened a small dockside cafe serving fresh seafood. 他們在碼頭邊開了一家供應新鮮海鮮的小咖啡館。
The battleship was built in the Royal Dockyard. 這艘戰艦是在皇家造船廠建造的。
He found a job as an apprentice at the local dockyard. 他在當地的造船廠找到了一份學徒工作。
The dockyardman specialized in repairing steel hulls. 這名造船廠工人專門修理鋼製船殼。
Thousands of dockyardmen were employed during the war. 戰爭期間雇用了數千名造船廠工人。
The docmac is a large catfish found in African rivers. docmac 是非洲河流中發現的一種大型鯰魚。
Local fishermen often catch docmac in Lake Victoria. 當地漁民經常在維多利亞湖捕獲這種鯰魚。
Docoglossa is a group of gastropods that includes many limpets. 笠螺亞目是一類腹足綱動物，包括許多笠螺。
The study of Docoglossa provides insights into the evolution of mollusks. 對笠螺亞目的研究提供了對軟體動物演化的見解。

meaning: （動物學）笠螺亞目的；笠螺亞目動物
sentences: The researcher collected several docoglossan specimens from the rocky shore. 研究人員從岩石海岸採集了幾個笠螺亞目標本。
Docoglossan teeth are extremely hard due to mineral reinforcement. 笠螺亞目動物的牙齒由於礦物質強化而非常堅硬。
Docoglossate radulae are characteristic of certain primitive snails. 笠螺型齒舌是某些原始蝸牛的特徵。
The anatomical study confirmed the docoglossate nature of the specimen. 解剖研究證實了該標本具有笠螺型齒舌的特性。
Docosane is a straight-chain alkane with twenty-two carbon atoms. 二十二烷是具有二十二個碳原子的直鏈烷烴。
The chemist synthesized docosane for the experiment. 化學家為實驗合成了二十二烷。
She was doctorally qualified to lead the research project. 她具備博士資格來領導該研究專案。

sentences: The merchant hired a dubash to facilitate trade with local officials. 商人聘請了一位通譯來促進與當地官員的貿易。
